💡 How to Style Lace in 2026

The Layering Trend: Lace isn’t just for special occasions anymore. In 2026, it’s all about everyday lace:

  • Layer a lace cami under a blazer for the office
  • Wear lace shorts over tights for fall
  • Style a lace top under a sweater for texture

Color Palette: This year’s most popular lace colors are:

  • Classic white and cream
  • Romantic blush pink
  • Sophisticated black
  • Earthy nude and champagne

Care Tips:

  • Hand wash or use gentle cycle
  • Lay flat to dry (lace can stretch)
  • Store hanging to prevent wrinkles
  • Use a lingerie bag for machine washing
